policy_notes.implementation: These notes document the policy implemented in app/rules.py; they are not executable policy switches.
policy_notes.matching: Automatically match reliable PAN/GSTIN evidence to one vendor-master record. Do not require a manually entered vendor ID.
policy_notes.comparison: Compare names, identifiers, bank details and any extracted address across documents and against the matched master. Do not fill missing document evidence from master data.
policy_notes.gst: Require a GST certificate when GST evidence exists or the matched master has a GSTIN. A new vendor without GST evidence must provide an explicit written non-registration explanation; an absent GSTIN alone is not an explanation.
policy_notes.approved: Configured completeness and consistency checks passed against an existing approved vendor record.
policy_notes.pending: Missing, unreadable, uncertain or conflicting evidence; changed details; ambiguous identity; or a vendor not yet verified in the master.
policy_notes.rejected: Reliable document identifiers match a blocked vendor record.
policy_notes.contacts: Contact name, email and phone are optional. Extract them only if visible. Missing contact details do not block a document decision.
policy_notes.profiles: Heading/label matching assists classification and does not establish authenticity.
policy_notes.fixtures: cases.json supplies synthetic document generator inputs. expected_results.json is an offline test answer key. Neither file is used as evidence by the app.
